links.title: Nohuto's and our Ghidra decompilation - Decompiled timer-serialization gate
links.summary: Nohuto's decompiled KeInitializeTimerTable mirror and our 25H2 Ghidra exports both point at the timer-serialization gate. The repo-backed fallback pass re-opened the previously open 140c63068 block from the earlier xref, forced a temporary function boundary, and wrote the resulting decompile plus structured evidence.json into the canonical ghidra folder.

links.title: Bounded KVM ETW stackwalk captures exact SerializeTimerExpiration helper query
links.summary: A bounded 2026-04-24 KVM ETW stackwalk run retained ETL, XML, summary, stage, and normalized-bundle artifacts. The retained bundle contains one exact helper-triggered RegQueryValue event for SerializeTimerExpiration under Session Manager\Kernel, which closes the runtime helper-query lane while leaving natural boot-consumer semantics open.
